283808756.description: This lot includes three natural mineral specimens featuring distinct crystal formations. The calcite cluster has a beige, translucent, layered appearance with visible crystal growth. The amethyst quartz geode displays vibrant purple hues with well-defined crystalline structure. The pyrite cluster shows a metallic gold color with a shiny luster and cubic crystal habit.

284739443.description:
Two mineral pieces. One is a polished faceted geometric stone in pale green and cream with a band of orange-red. The other is a rough petrified wood specimen in reddish brown, kept in a clear plastic vial with a blue snap lid and a handwritten label reading Petrified Wood.

Condition: Pre-owned. The polished stone has small surface scratches and a few dark specks. The plastic vial is scratched and has a cracked base.

Ornate Cast Brass Double Inkstand
Brass Desk Set with Pen Tray
Victorian Renaissance Revival Style, 20th Century
This elaborate cast brass double inkstand exemplifies the ornate decorative styling of Victorian and Renaissance Revival desk accessories. The piece features a high-relief crest with reclining winged cherubs flanking a central putto mask, two removable domed inkwell covers, and an integral scalloped pen tray centered by a detailed grotesque Green Man face with a spreading foliate beard.
Heavy cast brass construction with classical figural and foliate motifs
Two inkwell compartments with matching floral-finial domed lids
Back crest adorned with winged cherubs flanking a putto mask
Integrated scallop pen tray with central grotesque mask
